title: Pais's career at Navy programs and Space Force

tellings.quote: fortunate to work for strategic systems programs at the Washington Navy Yard and then uh I went for the Space Force and

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for patents on unusual craft, says he was fortunate to work for Strategic Systems Programs, a Navy office at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, D.C., and then went on to work for the Space Force, the US military branch for space. He describes his career this way on a podcast, as background to his patents and his credibility.
